SELECT name
FROM Highschooler
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Friend
    WHERE Friend.student_id = Highschooler.ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Likes
    WHERE Likes.liked_id = Highschooler.ID
);
FINAL SQL:

);
